focus.title: Count every atom of an element on each side.
focus.body: Oxygen often appears in more than one product. Add the oxygen in each product before choosing the coefficient of O2.
focus.code:
4 CO2: 4 x 2 = 8 oxygen atoms
6 H2O: 6 x 1 = 6 oxygen atoms
8 + 6 = 14, so 7 O2

focus.title: Two pieces of evidence are two different observations.
focus.body: A gas given off is one piece of evidence of a chemical change. A change of colour, a new solid, or heat or light given off are others.

closing: Your formulas and your single displacement were secure, and they are the base the next unit builds on. Counting oxygen across every product is one careful habit away: try it on the practice equations, adding each product's oxygen before you choose a coefficient.
